messages:
maya: quick heads-up — planning to flip the precision gate for a small canary tomorrow 10am PT. target audience = 2% users on dedicated pools. asking for checklist + signoffs :raised_hands:
kevin: can you paste the exact flag key + rollout config? also want to confirm fallback behavior if perf regressions show up.
sophia: +1 to checking embedding similarity thresholds. last INT8 canary showed a 0.7% drift on semantic-sim test. need guardrail thresholds.
maya: flag key = `precision.toggle.fp16_int8_v2`. rollout yaml snippet:
```yaml
flag: precision.toggle.fp16_int8_v2
canary: 0.02 # 2%
audience: dedicated_gpu_pools
metrics: [latency_p50, latency_p99, embedding_cosine_mean, error_rate]
fallback: revert-to=fp16
rollout_window: 30m
```
julian: for the fallback, can we make it automatic revert-on-p99>200ms OR embedding_cosine_mean < 0.92 ? Those seem safe.
kevin: agree on automated revert. add a manual alert channel too (#eng-oncall + paging). also include memory OOM metric — previously some hosts spiked.
ron: quick CR ping — I left comments in #repo:serving-config PR 482. mainly on the gating evaluation (edge-case for small batch sizes).
maya: saw the CR comments, thanks ron. @kevin @sophia can you confirm the evaluation harness includes small-batch (1-2) and long-context traces?
sophia: yes, added tests for batch=1 and seq_len=4096 in the canary eval. also included a prompt set that historically regressions hit.
kevin: infra note — autoscaler will still scale but dedicated pool routing might change token distribution; double-check cost model for 2% audience. wont be huge but log it.
maya: deploy-bot will run the smoke deploy and post the preview link. planning to schedule smoke at 9:30am PT, flip at 10am PT if smoke is clean.
deploy-bot: smoke-deploy started for `precision.toggle.fp16_int8_v2` at 1767778200. CI: all checks passed. canary-preview: https://canary.reddemo/preview/1767777000
julian: quick question — are we gating embeddings and generation separately? want different thresholds if yes.
maya: yes, gating applies to model runtime variant. embeddings route has separate metric set in the YAML above. we will monitor both in console dashboards.
kevin: final ask: add a short rollback playbook in the thread with exact CLI commands. eg:
```bash
# rollback to previous precision
redwoodctl feature disable precision.toggle.fp16_int8_v2 --namespace=prod
redwoodctl rollouts cancel --flag=precision.toggle.fp16_int8_v2
```
sophia: adding the playbook to the runbook doc now.
maya: great. unless objections, will proceed with schedule. please post any hold requests by EOD today. :thumbsup:
ron: lgtm from me. small note — observe latency p50 on legacy models, sometimes they spike when mixing INT8 backends. will watch.
julian: lgtm. will keep an eye on embedding cosine drift.
kevin: lgtm. will configure alerting on p99 and embedding_cosine_mean < 0.925.
maya: thanks all — will post final confirmation 9:15am PT tomorrow after smoke.
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: smoke-deploy @ 9:30am PT tomorrow. CI link: https://ci.reddemo/checks/482
